'''Marus Grayson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]]. He owned the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gem]] which he hoped to auction. After catching the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Gantel Dro]] trying to steal the gem from his [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Marus Grayson's apartment|apartment]] the Imperial offered the criminal the choice of working security for him or [[Death/Legends|dying]]. Dro accepted and accompanied Grayson to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where Grayson planned to auction the gem.
